methods.association: Descriptive tie-adjusted rank AUC (no fitted model); matched by path, 10ms slack and 10ms SRTT strata
methods.correlations: pairwise complete Pearson and Spearman; high overlap at absolute r >= .90
methods.distributions: sample SD, linear quantiles, Tukey 1.5 IQR; null fence for zero IQR
methods.drift: Empirical two-sample KS and missingness delta (validation minus train); small <=.10, mild <=.25, large >.25. No iid inference.
exact_collinearity: rate_Bps determined by cwnd_bytes and rtt_us (integer floor)
send_budget_bytes determined by cwnd_bytes and in_flight_bytes
rtt_to_slack determined by rtt_us and slack_us
methods.sparse_association: <20 positive or negative observations, or <12 seeds
